acceptanceCriteria: TestTMV0008_ProbedTreeReadParity/clean compares `queue status` envelopes with the wall-clock completions.observedAt pinned or normalised, so a second boundary between the on and off runs cannot fail it.
The test still fails if any other byte of the on/off envelopes differs.
body: Observed 2026-10-09 on PR beamfall/corvint#703 (head 828e3d67, CI run 37990644403, go-product-shard (4)). TestTMV0008_ProbedTreeReadParity/clean failed: the `queue status` envelopes from the probed-tree on and off runs were identical except completions.observedAt (2026-10-09T21:06:48Z vs 21:06:47Z). internal/tasks/cli/cli.go:1386 takes observedAt from time.Now() with no injectable clock, and probed_tree_parity_test.go compares the two runs with bytes.Equal. Expected: parity holds regardless of wall clock. Actual: flaky failure whenever the two runs straddle a second boundary. The PR change itself (.github CI wiring) does not touch this path. Present on main 99f6a03f.
